VghLantern__ValeDatabase__Config__Descri: System configuration overlay for the placeholder Vale Database API. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly. The lookup module simulates an async SQL fetch against the phoney client table; when the real Vale SQL endpoint exists, ClientTablePath is replaced by a request URL and SimulatedLatencyMs is retired.

VghLantern__ValeDatabase__Config__Lookup.SimulatedLatencyNote: Artificial delay before a lookup resolves, so the fetching state is actually visible when demonstrating the flow. A real database round trip provides its own latency; set to 0 once the SQL integration lands.
VghLantern__ValeDatabase__Config__Lookup.JobNumberRuleNote: Vale standard job numbers are plain integers of 4 or 5 digits with no leading zero, e.g. 1256 or 15134.
